About Our Company

INNOVATORS IN PACKING TECHNOLOGY

Brihath Foam Tech Industries is a pioneering force in the realm of packaging technology, its roots firmly embedded in the industry since its establishment in 1998. With an unwavering vision, we strive to be the foremost leader, challenging conventional boundaries and redefining industry standards through our relentless pursuit of innovation, sustainable practices, and a commitment to global excellence that knows no bounds.

Our mission is driven by an unyielding determination to deliver foam solutions that transcend mere client requirements, crafted to exceed even the loftiest of expectations. We foster a corporate culture that celebrates innovation as its lifeblood, where creative minds converge to push the boundaries of what’s possible. Environmental responsibility is woven into the fabric of our being, guiding our actions and shaping our approach to minimize our ecological footprint.

Learn more from our FAQ

Here are some frequently asked questions to help provide a clearer understanding of our services and operations:

How can I get in touch with Brihath Foam Tech Industries?

You can contact us via our website's contact form, by phone at +919500996906, or via email at brihath@precisiongroups.com . Our customer service team is ready to assist you with any inquiries.

What products does Brihath Foam Tech Industries offer?

Brihath Foam Tech Industries offers a wide range of foam and packaging products, including EVA Foams, EPE Foams, Airbubble Film, Paper Packaging, EPDM Foams, Other Packaging Products, XLPE Insulation Foam, Civil Products, and Consumer Products

Are your products customizable?

Yes, many of our products, such as EVA Foam Fitments and EPE Foam Fitments, are customizable to fit specific shapes and sizes. Please contact our sales team for more information on custom orders
